Terms: [docs/GLOSSARY.md](../../docs/GLOSSARY.md).

Engine `66be26997` — OBSERVATIONAL, pre-registered (prereg_scalp_risk_grid_v1, register 103). Refinement-program extension; v0 UNTOUCHED; measurement only. FIELD HONESTY: 144 cells across both ladders (rungs x legs x arms x windows); single-leg glints listed never chained; a candidate needs >= 3 of 4 forward legs clearing its member band, same sign; any survivor proposes JOINTLY with (or against) the register-101 derivation as one ratification package — nothing registers here. STATISTIC SHAPES (74-B): per-cell net vs v0 (stop ladder) / vs no-cooldown (cooldown ladder) against B-RANDOM member bands under identical rules; the reacher-MAE curve and the mechanism cut are descriptive. The stop ladder RE-SIMULATES the arms' own fires with the recipe engine — the incumbent rung reconciles to the journal (printed per leg). Register 101's v1 derivation (p75 of forward non-reach MAE) is the standing arbiter when its sample measures.
